scripts.title: Auto Build And More
scripts.features:
🏗️ AUTO BUILD: Say goodbye to manual construction! This script allows you to automatically build your empire, saving you valuable time and energy. Watch your tycoon grow effortlessly!

💼 AUTO BUY WORKER: Tired of constantly purchasing workers? Say no more! The OP SCRIPT will do it for you, ensuring you have a strong and efficient workforce at all times. Sit back and witness your productivity skyrocket!

⏩ HATCH FAST: Waiting for eggs to hatch can be tedious, but not anymore! This script speeds up the hatching process, giving you instant access to powerful creatures. Get ready to dominate the battlefield in no time!
